blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab is heading ko 'Full0-Wave Rectification' chhapti hai; sahi 'Full-Wave Rectification' hai.

Jis rectification mein input AC ke dono aadhe cycles resistance mein ek hi direction ka current bhejte hain, use full-wave rectification kehte hain. Yeh bridge rectifier se hoti hai: chaar diodes ek closed loop 'bridge' (pul) ki shakal mein jore jate hain. Transformer ki secondary winding bridge ke ek taraf aur load doosri taraf juri hoti hai. Chaar diodes D₁ se D₄ 'series pairs' (joriyon) mein hain: har aadhe cycle mein sirf do diodes current chalate hain (Fig. 17.15(a)).

blocks.alt: Chaar diodes D1 se D4 ka bridge; corners A (oopar) aur B (neeche) AC source V se jure; baqi do corners load R par +V aur 0V dete, darmiyan DC output. Current I source se A ki taraf aur B se wapas, aur +V lakeer par load ki taraf.
blocks.caption: Figure 17.15 (a): Chaar diodes aur load resistance wala full-wave bridge rectifier circuit (kitab ki Figure 17.15 (a) ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.text: Positive aadha cycle: diode sirf forward bias mein current chalata hai. Supply ke positive aadhe cycle (0 se T/2) mein bridge ka terminal A, terminal B ke muqable positive hota hai. Ab D₁ aur D₂ forward bias ho kar series mein current chalate hain, D₃ aur D₄ reverse bias hain, aur current load resistance R mein se guzarta hai (Fig. 17.15(b)).

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text:
PN junction diode ke istemal:
1. Rectification
2. Signal clipping (signal ka hissa kaatna)
3. Regulation (voltage control)
4. Clamping voltage
5. Signal detection
6. Photovoltaic (solar) cells
7. Switching aur roshni nikalna (LED)

blocks.alt: Baen: input wave, 0 se 4 pi. Beech mein, oopar neeche: positive half cycle (0 se T/2, D1 aur D2, green teer) aur negative half cycle (T/2 se T, D3 aur D4, pink teer) mein bridge; dono dafa load R mein current neeche ki taraf. Daen, oopar neeche: teen output strips: D1 aur D2 conducting (pehle aur teesre half cycle mein pulse), D3 aur D4 conducting (doosre aur chauthe mein), aur final output jis mein har half cycle mein pulse.
blocks.caption: Figure 17.15 (b), (c): Full-wave bridge rectifier positive aur negative half cycles mein, input aur output waves ke saath (kitab ki Figure 17.15 (b), (c) ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke graphs par 'Half wave Bridge rectifier' likha hai. Bridge rectifier full-wave rectifier hai: har aadhe cycle mein do diodes chalte hain aur final output mein har aadhe cycle ka pulse hota hai; drawing mein yahi dikhaya gaya hai.

Negative aadha cycle: (T/2 se T) terminal A negative aur B positive hota hai. Ab D₃ aur D₄ series mein current chalate hain aur D₁, D₂ reverse bias ho kar band (OFF) ho jate hain. Load mein current pehle wali direction mein hi behta hai (Fig. 17.15(c)). Figs. 17.15(b) aur (c) ko compare (muqabla) karein: dono aadhe cycles mein load mein current ki direction ek hi hai. Yani input ke dono half cycles load mein unidirectional current bhejte hain. Output smooth (hamwar) nahi balke pulsating hai; capacitors wale filter circuit se ise smooth kiya ja sakta hai. Mobile phone chargers mein aam taur par full-wave bridge rectifier hota hai jo deewar ke socket ka AC, battery charge karne ke liye DC mein badalta hai.

blocks.alt: Mains input step-down transformer se guzarta hai jis ki secondary (oopar +, neeche -) chaar diodes ke bridge ko deti hai. Chalne wale do diodes pink hain aur pink lakeer current I ko un se aur load se neeche earth tak dikhati hai. Chhote sketches AC input (aik half cycle red) aur 0 V ke oopar full-wave output (pehla pulse red) dikhate hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 17.16 (a): Mobile charger mein full-wave bridge rectifier ka circuit (kitab ki Figure 17.16 (a) ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.alt: Kala chaukor package jis par 'Full wave bridge rectifier' likha hai; us ki chaar metal taangon (legs) ke oopar +, ~, ~ aur − ke nishan hain; legs par DC out, Ac in, Ac in aur DC out likha hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 17.16 (b): Electronics mein istemal hone wala compact full wave bridge rectifier (kitab ki Figure 17.16 (b) ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Chaaron diodes aik hi package ke andar hain. Darmiyan wali do legs (~) par AC aata hai; bahar wali do legs (+ aur −) se DC nikalta hai.
